item.description:
Profile (CV)

Yuki Wakai

Education

  • Doctor of Informatics, Graduate School of Informatics, Kyoto University, Japan
    April 2025 – Present
    Supervisor: Professor Hisashi Kashima

  • Master of Informatics, Graduate School of Informatics, Kyoto University, Japan
    April 2023 – March 2025
    Supervisor: Professor Hisashi Kashima

  • Bachelor of Informatics, Faculty of Engineering, Kyoto University, Japan
    April 2019 – March 2023
    Awarded the SICE Outstanding Student Award

Research

Research Interests

  • Security and privacy of large language models and large multimodal models
  • Privacy-preserving data mining of point cloud data
  • Machine learning for real-world data analysis and optimization

Refereed Publications

  • Privacy-Preserving Image Annotation by Large Multimodal Models
    ICPR 2026, to be published
    Yuki Wakai, Kyohei Atarashi, Koh Takeuchi, Hisashi Kashima
    Proposed a method to employ large multimodal models for automated image annotation while addressing data privacy concerns.

  • Robust In-Context Defenses against Jailbreaking of LLMs via Role Specification
    ICASSP 2026
    Yuki Wakai, Kunihiro Ito, Hisashi Kashima
    Demonstrated that specifying roles in prompts improves the robustness of large language models without compromising response quality.

  • Understanding Privacy Risks of Large Language Models in Japanese Based on Training Data Extraction Attacks
    AsiaCCS 2025 Workshop
    Yuki Wakai, Toshiki Shibahara, Rina Okada, Takayuki Miura, Hiroki Kinoshita
    Investigated the robustness of Japanese-compatible large language models against training data extraction attacks.

  • Recovering Population Dynamics from a Single Point Cloud Snapshot
    PAKDD 2024, acceptance rate below 25%
    Yuki Wakai, Koh Takeuchi, Hisashi Kashima
    Proposed a method to estimate population dynamics from a single point cloud snapshot without time-series information or features other than coordinates.

Domestic Presentations

  • Recovering Population Dynamics from a Single Point Cloud Snapshot
    JSAI 2023

  • Privacy-Preserving Data Annotation Automation by Large Multimodal Models
    JSAI 2024

Projects

  • Jailbreak Detection Models for LLMs
    SecHack365 2023
    Implemented machine learning models to detect prompts that attempt to circumvent the safety guardrails of large language models.

  • Image Model Distillation via Human-in-the-Loop
    Google Summer of Code 2025, OpenVINO organization
    Implemented a pipeline to train edge-deployable image models through collaborative annotation with humans and large foundation models.

  • IoT System for Traditional Japanese Houses in Kyoto
    Developed an IoT-enabled smart lock system for the entrance of a traditional Japanese house in Kyoto. The project won corporate awards at hackathons.

Work Experience

Long-Term Internships

  • Research Intern, NEC Corporation
    October 2024 – November 2024
    Researched methods to improve the security and robustness of large language models against jailbreaking.

  • Research Intern, NTT Communication
    August 2024 – September 2024
    Evaluated privacy and security risks of large language models based on training data extraction attacks.

  • Engineering Intern, Recruit Holdings Co., Ltd.
    October 2023 – December 2023
    Worked as a data scientist and machine learning engineer. Improved recommendation models for a dating app and analyzed large-scale application data on BigQuery.

  • Engineering Intern, Fast Retailing Co., Ltd.
    October 2023 – December 2023
    Implemented optimization models for inventory planning.

  • Research Intern, Preferred Networks, Inc.
    August 2023 – September 2023
    Researched and developed weather estimation and prediction methods using 3D weather radar data.

  • Research Intern, LeapMind, Inc.
    August 2022 – October 2022
    Implemented anomaly classification models on quantized neural networks.
    Internship article: https://leapmind.io/news/detail/summer-internship-2022-wakai-investigate-the-possibility-of-anomaly-classification-on-quantized-neural-networks/

  • Engineering Intern, Future Corporation
    August 2022 – September 2022
    Improved the accuracy of optical character recognition models and developed a pipeline to automatically create real-world Japanese character datasets using OCR models.

Short-Term Internships

  • Toyota Motor Corporation
    September 2023
    Analyzed vehicle data and explored potential use cases.

  • Knowledge Work, Inc.
    May 2023
    Developed a Go library to support testing of parallel processing.

  • CyberAgent, Inc.
    September 2022
    Improved machine learning models and API servers for recommendation systems, and analyzed video viewing data.

  • Nikkei Inc.
    September 2022
    Developed a system to automatically generate thumbnail images from newspaper article titles using Stable Diffusion.

  • CyberAgent, Inc.
    February 2022 – March 2022
    Developed game API servers.

Part-Time Experience

  • RUTILEA, Inc.
    April 2022 – Present
    Worked on a proof-of-concept project to estimate container filling rates from LiDAR point cloud data.

  • Datagrid, Inc.
    October 2022 – March 2023
    Worked on improving the efficiency of compound exploration in drug discovery using machine learning.

Affiliations

  • Kashima Laboratory, Graduate School of Informatics, Kyoto University
  • KaiRA, Kyoto University Artificial Intelligence Research Association
    https://kyoto-kaira.github.io/
  • CAMPHOR, IT student community in Kyoto
    https://camph.net/#top
  • SecHack365 2023 Trainee
    Researched pre-detection methods for prompt injection and jailbreak attempts.

Development Experience

I have been programming since junior high school and have experience with Python, Go, C, C++, Java, OCaml, Verilog, and other languages.

During my master’s program, I worked on several machine learning and data science internships, including weather prediction from 3D radar data, recommendation model improvement for a dating app, large-scale data analysis with BigQuery, and inventory optimization.

During my undergraduate research, I joined Kashima Laboratory, where I worked on data analysis and applied machine learning. I also gained practical experience through internships and part-time roles involving anomaly detection on quantized neural networks, OCR model improvement, Japanese character dataset construction, and machine learning for compound exploration in drug discovery.

I have also worked on systems programming and backend development. As an undergraduate, I implemented a CPU with a five-stage pipeline and branch prediction on an FPGA using Verilog. I also implemented interpreters and type inference programs using OCaml, and developed backend API servers in Go during an internship.

In my second year of university, I developed a Python program for Kyoto University students that automatically collected assignment lists by scraping a course website and supported scheduled assignment submissions.

I have participated in competitive programming since my first year of university. On AtCoder, I reached a rating of 1382, corresponding to the cyan rank.

item.title: SecHack365に合格しました
item.description:
SecHack365に合格しました。

SecHack365(NICTが主催する1年間の長期ハッカソン)に合格しました！

SecHack365では、大規模言語モデルのセキュリティ、特に大規模言語モデルに存在するプロンプトインジェクションという脆弱性の防御手法を開発・実装しています。プロンプトインジェクション攻撃は、特殊なプロンプト(命令文)を入力することによって、大規模言語モデルの開発者が意図しない出力を誘導する脆弱性攻撃です。

大規模言語モデルはテキスト分析や翻訳、要約といったさまざまなタスクで革新的な性能を発揮しており、産学を問わず応用可能性が模索されています。 大規模言語モデルをアプリケーションに応用するにあたって、プロンプトインジェクションから大規模言語モデルを防御する手法が求められていると思い、今後研究開発を行っていきます！
